Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding powers of the governing boards of institutions of higher education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to governing boards of institutions of highereducation; and adding a new section to chapter 28B.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28B.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The governing boards of the institutions of higher education of thestate of Washington shall have any and all powers necessary to carryout their missions and shall exercise those powers to carry out thepurposes of this title and those purposes necessarily impliedtherefrom, unless specifically prohibited by law.
